description: The chart illustrates the average JGA score for two models, LLaMA-7B and T5-small, across different turn IDs. The horizontal axis represents the turn ID, labeled with values ranging from 0 to 26 in increments of 2, while the vertical axis represents the average JGA score, labeled with values from 0.2 to 1 in increments of 0.1. The chart features grouped bars, with each group containing two bars representing the two models, colored orange for LLaMA-7B and yellow for T5-small. At turn ID 0, both models have an average JGA score of approximately 0.95. As the turn ID increases, the scores generally decrease, with LLaMA-7B consistently outperforming T5-small. The scores for LLaMA-7B range from approximately 0.95 at turn ID 0 to around 0.35 at turn ID 24, while T5-small's scores range from approximately 0.95 at turn ID 0 to around 0.3 at turn ID 24. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
